assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: production pixel-art animated VFX spritesheet for a mobile fantasy game, no characters. Reference image is the provided boss skill sheet; keep its pixel-art rendering and identity but make clearly consecutive motion frames. Create a strict 4-ROW by EIGHT-COLUMN grid, 32 complete separate frames, equal cell spacing with generous real TRANSPARENT padding. Output aspect ratio 8:4; each cell square. Every row is ONE evolving effect, frame1 through8 left to right, consistent anchor and scale within a row, no jitter, no neighboring frame overlap. Palette: forest guardian earth/leaf magic in emerald green, tan soil, warm golden impact light. Row1: a compact green root-energy ring charging from small wisps to a held glowing wreath, buildup sequence. Row2: a seamless horizontal rightward green leaf-and-earth dash wake, flowing leaves and tiny dirt motes, keep wake centered, loop. Row3: earth slam: bright contact spark, upward stone debris eruption, expanding gold shockwave, fragments falling, wispy dissipating dust; one continuous burst from contact through decay. Row4: low tan rock fragments and green leaf motes settling after a slam, the debris gradually drops and dissipates, one-shot aftermath. All ground-effect footprints are centered in the lower part of each cell with the same contact baseline at about 78% of cell height. No labels, no numbers, no gridlines, no HUD, no warning arrows, no text, no scenery, no character bodies. Effects remain inside their cell with at least 10% transparent gutters including glow. The art should be crisp readable pixel art, simple silhouettes at small size, restrained glow, no background haze. Animate substance changing shape across frames, don't merely increase size or duplicate the same picture. Preserve real transparent alpha.
